templates.name: H3 提示词：文本、首帧与参考
templates.summary: 同一座舱创意分别改写为文生视频、首帧图生视频及真正 Ref2VA，比较时间线与参考约束。

fields.label: 主体与外观
fields.default: a stationary concept electric car cabin with cream woven seats and a teal ambient-light strip

fields.label: 场景与光线
fields.default: a parked car in a quiet studio, soft daylight enters from the left

fields.label: 一个主要动作
fields.default: a passenger presses one physical comfort button; the teal light gently brightens and then holds

fields.label: 需要保留的外观
fields.default: seat stitching, dashboard outline, screen proportions and teal accent color

fields.label: Picture 1 的参考作用
fields.default: the cabin layout and material appearance, without copying any printed text

fields.label: 非场景配乐方向
fields.default: two soft marimba notes over a slow sustained synth pad, no vocals

stages: 先选输入模式，填写主体、动作和参考角色
审核时间线、参考标签与可见文字
只执行所需模式并人工检查结果
checklist: 每镜先交代构图，再写可观察动作、运镜幅度和速度
首帧模式的动作从图片状态出发，不能立即换场
Ref2VA 标签只指向实际上传图片，角色与材质保持一致
场内声音和观众听到的配乐分开，不在环境音重复台词
notes: 三项是同一简报的模式变体，不是必须连续执行的三镜短片。
首帧模式需上传一张首帧；Ref2VA 默认也只引用 <Picture 1>，但把它作为身份/风格参考而非锁定首帧。增加图片后需自行补齐各段标签和作用。
表单不自动翻译；英文描述有利于贴合官方指南，台词和画面文字应保留其原始语言。FL2VA/L2VA 仅保留为官方扩展知识，本地界面未提供尾帧输入。
本模板通过离线表单替换字段，不调用 LLM，不自动核验资料、分析音乐、识别图片或改写用户内容。
逐项选择分镜并手动执行；需要图片输入时，请先保存、检查并自行上传或选择正确参考图，不会自动串联前一步输出。
图像 1024×1024、视频 512×512/4 秒为低显存探测设置；画质、耗时与显存均未保证。H3 帧网格会令名义 4 秒约为 4.458 秒。

shots.title: 纯文本：建立并完成一个动作
shots.description: 无需参考图，检查主体、位置、动作和音画关系。

prompt.visual: [Shot 1] Live-action concept visualization of {{subject}} in {{scene}}. Begin with a medium-wide composition, console centered and the seat visible at right. During 0-1s establish the still cabin. During 1-3s {{action}}. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed; during 3-4s it stops and holds the result. Preserve {{identity}}. No road driving, no extra interface panels, no unrequested readable text.
prompt.soundscape: Low ventilation room tone continues; one tactile switch click occurs at the press, followed by a short restrained confirmation chime.

shots.title: 首帧：从已确认座舱图发展
shots.description: 手动选择一张座舱首帧；只让明确动作发生。

prompt.visual: [Shot 1] Begin in the exact visible composition of <Picture 1>, showing {{subject}} in {{scene}}. Preserve {{identity}}, object positions and the direction of the light. From 0-1s the existing cabin remains stable. From 1-3s {{action}} without adding new objects. The camera makes one small, slow push in. From 3-4s hold the completed state; no cut, no reset to another cabin, no added text.
prompt.soundscape: The same quiet ventilation continues. Synchronize one physical button click with contact and keep the confirmation chime low.

shots.title: Ref2VA：身份和材质参考
shots.description: 上传一张图片作为外观参考；允许新机位，不把它冒充第一帧。

prompt.visual: The target video is a restrained live-action concept visualization. [Shot 1] Show <Subject 1>, {{subject}}, in {{scene}}, from a new three-quarter view. The reference provides appearance rather than an exact first-frame composition. Establish the console and right-hand seat during 0-1s. During 1-3s {{action}}. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed, then holds during 3-4s. Keep {{identity}} visible and stable. No unrequested text or additional controls.
prompt.soundscape: Low ventilation and a single button click; a short confirmation chime follows the physical action.

reference.subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the visible cabin in <Picture 1>. Reference role: {{reference_role}}. Track these appearance features: {{identity}}.
reference.summary: [reference generation] Create a new view of <Subject 1> for a short concept demonstration: {{action}}.
reference.retention_analysis: <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain {{identity}}. <Picture 1> supplies {{reference_role}}; its original viewpoint is not a required target frame.

templates.name: 品牌宣传：从场景到产品回报
templates.summary: 先列真实素材和功能边界，再用场景、交互、回报组织一条短品牌概念片。

fields.label: 项目或品牌名
fields.default: CabinFlow concept

fields.label: 本次只展示的功能
fields.default: one physical button changes the parked cabin from cool neutral light to a warm rest setting

fields.label: 受众与使用场景
fields.default: a passenger taking a quiet break in a stationary car

fields.label: 品牌色与材质
fields.default: warm cream fabric, graphite trim and one muted teal accent

fields.label: 概念文案或已核验主张
fields.default: A pause that feels yours

fields.label: 素材来源与事实边界
fields.default: Original concept with no production specifications, no performance statistics and no official brand logos

stages: 人工填写素材来源与功能事实表
确认场景—动作—结果的故事主线
先看主视觉再按镜头生成片段
人工检查品牌保真并在本地剪辑软件组装
checklist: 功能、主张与素材来源是否一致，概念内容是否清楚标注
单镜只突出一个主要动作，控制面板和文字不要抢主体
LOGO、字体与真实产品截图需人工使用正确原件
结尾回报与开头需求形成因果关系，不能用特效代替证据
notes: 本地表单不打开官网、不验证素材真实性；facts 是制作备注，需用户自行核验。
概念图不能当作量产功能证据。真实 LOGO、界面原件及精确 CTA 合成需外部本地后期，生成模型不能保证标识或文字逐像素保真。
每段各自生成原生音轨，不会自动无缝合成或统一响度。
本模板通过离线表单替换字段，不调用 LLM，不自动核验资料、分析音乐、识别图片或改写用户内容。
逐项选择分镜并手动执行；需要图片输入时，请先保存、检查并自行上传或选择正确参考图，不会自动串联前一步输出。
图像 1024×1024、视频 512×512/4 秒为低显存探测设置；画质、耗时与显存均未保证。H3 帧网格会令名义 4 秒约为 4.458 秒。

shots.title: 场景主视觉确认图
shots.description: 先检查产品与受众场景；作为后续首帧候选。

prompt.visual: Create one clean full-frame concept key visual for {{brand}}. The subject is {{audience}}. Demonstrate only this intended idea: {{feature}}. Use {{palette}} with soft left-side daylight, a readable console silhouette and generous negative space. Show a parked car, no road driving. Production note: {{facts}}. No invented logo, figures, certification badges, captions or decorative HUD. The output is a single scene, not a storyboard.
prompt.soundscape: N/A

shots.title: 交互机制：动作产生可见结果
shots.description: 选择已检查的主视觉图作为首帧。

prompt.visual: [Shot 1] Begin with the composition and cabin appearance in <Picture 1>. This is a concept scene for {{brand}} with {{palette}}. During 0-1s establish the current control and lighting state. During 1-3s visibly demonstrate {{feature}}, using one clear hand action and one visual response. The camera makes a small slow push toward the control. During 3-4s hold the completed setting. Preserve product geometry and the passenger's position. No invented metrics, logos or additional panels.
prompt.soundscape: Quiet cabin ventilation, a physical switch click and a brief restrained interface tone. No spoken marketing claims.
prompt.music: A sparse slow plucked-synth pattern, low in volume, no vocals.

shots.title: 体验回报与概念收束
shots.description: 单独生成回报镜；与首镜素材人工比对并在外部剪辑。

prompt.visual: [Shot 1] Medium-wide view of {{audience}} in the same {{palette}} concept cabin for {{brand}}. During 0-1s establish the already completed comfort state. During 1-3s the passenger relaxes their shoulders and places a hand on the fabric armrest; the camera holds still. During 3-4s keep the cabin stable with clear negative space. The creative message is {{claim}}; do not render this sentence or a logo into the shot. Show an observable quiet pause rather than unverified product claims.
prompt.soundscape: Soft fabric movement and low ventilation, no dialogue or voiceover.
prompt.music: A sustained soft chord with two widely spaced plucked notes, ending without a large swell.

templates.name: 极简产品广告：三张独立锚定图
templates.summary: 保留产品颜色和结构，用主视觉、细节、结尾三张独立图锁定一条克制的产品片。

fields.label: 产品与独特形态
fields.default: a compact circular in-car comfort controller with a knurled metal dial

fields.label: 产品真实主色
fields.default: deep teal with a graphite lower ring

fields.label: 材质与可见结构
fields.default: matte anodized aluminum, a precise knurled edge and one shallow physical button

fields.label: 一个真实可见动作
fields.default: the knurled dial rotates a small angle and settles into one detent

fields.label: 单行英文概念文案（3–5词）
fields.default: Comfort Within Easy Reach

fields.label: 背景与光线方向
fields.default: a matte warm-white studio background with soft light from the upper left and no reflective floor

stages: 选原始产品图并核对颜色与结构
分别生成主视觉、细节、结尾三张图片
人工确认锚定图和一个动作的节拍
选锚定图执行参考视频并逐帧质检
checklist: 主推款的真实颜色是否贯穿所有资产
三张锚定图是否独立完整，不能拼成宫格
画面只允许一个主要动作，产品轮廓不被遮挡
若尝试生成文案，保持同一时间一条单行、双色、足够停留
notes: 前三项 image-image 分别以同一张原始产品图为输入；请单独保存和检查每张，不要上传三宫格作为产品。
参考视频默认只使用已确认的主视觉 <Picture 1>；若需要三锚定图同时参考，请手动追加图片并明确 Picture 2/3 的细节与版式作用。
源流程的自动音乐生成、节奏检测、卡点剪辑和文案精确时序均未接入；本地外部后期可完成精确文字与总片合成。生成器尝试单行文案仍可能失败。
本模板通过离线表单替换字段，不调用 LLM，不自动核验资料、分析音乐、识别图片或改写用户内容。
逐项选择分镜并手动执行；需要图片输入时，请先保存、检查并自行上传或选择正确参考图，不会自动串联前一步输出。
图像 1024×1024、视频 512×512/4 秒为低显存探测设置；画质、耗时与显存均未保证。H3 帧网格会令名义 4 秒约为 4.458 秒。

shots.title: 锚定图 1：主视角
shots.description: 上传原始产品图，保持真实颜色、比例与接口。

prompt.visual: Use <Picture 1> as the sole identity source for {{product}}. Preserve its real shape and {{color}}; preserve {{material}}. Make one full-frame three-quarter hero product photograph against {{background}}. Let a controlled edge highlight explain the circular silhouette; keep generous empty space and a believable soft contact shadow. No added buttons, new logos, text, grids, multiple views, reflective stage or fake interface.
prompt.soundscape: N/A

shots.title: 锚定图 2：材质与机构
shots.description: 再次选择原始产品图；用细节机位核对结构。

prompt.visual: Preserve {{product}} from <Picture 1>, especially {{color}} and {{material}}. Create one close product photograph showing the knurled dial and its physical seam, with consistent light and background: {{background}}. The composition must make this mechanism plausible: {{action}}. Maintain scale and material hue. No split-screen, multiple products, labels, invented screws or floating parts.
prompt.soundscape: N/A

shots.title: 锚定图 3：结尾版式
shots.description: 再次选择原始产品图；检查文字拼写和留白。

prompt.visual: Preserve {{product}} from <Picture 1>, with {{color}} and {{material}}, against {{background}}. One full-frame stable product composition, product on the right and one short English line on the left reading exactly "{{copy}}". Set a clean semibold sans-serif line with dark-gray first words and final words in the main product hue from {{color}}, never wrapped; maintain generous spacing. No subtitles, second headline, brand logo, grid or storyboard.
prompt.soundscape: N/A

shots.title: Ref2VA：克制动作与文案收束
shots.description: 先选确认主视觉锚定图作为 Picture 1；不会自动选择前面结果。

prompt.visual: Minimalist product cinematography on {{background}}. [Shot 1] <Subject 1>, {{product}}, fills the right side with a readable silhouette. Preserve {{color}} and {{material}}. During 0-1s a small slow camera truck reveals the edge; during 1-2.5s {{action}}. From 2.5-3.5s one single-line text "{{copy}}" gently appears in the empty left space, dark-gray first words and final words in the main product hue from {{color}}, no wrapping. From 3.5-4s stop motion and hold one full-frame closing composition. No product wall, floating HUD or extra slogans.
prompt.soundscape: One quiet mechanical detent synchronized to the dial, with a low clean studio room tone.
prompt.music: A restrained moderate-tempo plucked synthesizer and light wooden percussion; no vocals or heavy bass.

reference.subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the controller in <Picture 1>, defined by {{product}}, {{color}} and {{material}}.
reference.summary: [reference generation] Make a short minimalist concept ad for <Subject 1>, showing {{action}} before a stable closing composition.
reference.retention_analysis: <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain product outline, {{color}} and {{material}}. <Picture 1> provides identity and light behavior, not a multi-panel layout.

templates.name: 双人游戏开场：角色与菜单联动
templates.summary: 先确认双人角色与统一菜单布局，再用轻动作表现 READY 与开场，适合驻车娱乐概念。

fields.label: 玩家一昵称
fields.default: MIA

fields.label: 玩家二昵称
fields.default: BO

fields.label: 游戏概念名
fields.default: CAMP SIDEKICKS

fields.label: 角色和界面风格
fields.default: warm stylized clay-like 3D adventure characters, bold silhouettes and clean console-menu design

fields.label: 统一配色（不超过5色）
fields.default: deep forest-green background, warm cream text, muted coral active controls and small charcoal accents

stages: 填写玩家名、游戏名、视觉风格和配色
生成菜单确认图并检查角色左右映射
手动选确认首图生成待机开场
检查文字、人物身份和单一高亮事件
checklist: 左侧玩家一与右侧玩家二是否保持明确身份和颜色区分
菜单不遮挡脸和手，按钮间距与文字层级一致
同一时间只有一个醒目的主按钮或一个主要交互事件
角色表情、界面背景与图标材质是否匹配已选风格
notes: 这是驻车双人娱乐的概念视频，不会生成可运行游戏、可点击菜单或真实车机界面。
如需真实玩家外观，请先在图像编辑模式用其参考图制作确认首图；模板默认使用原创角色，不自动识别人脸。
生成文字不能保证精确拼写；若菜单文字失真，减少文字并在外部本地后期排版。
本模板通过离线表单替换字段，不调用 LLM，不自动核验资料、分析音乐、识别图片或改写用户内容。
逐项选择分镜并手动执行；需要图片输入时，请先保存、检查并自行上传或选择正确参考图，不会自动串联前一步输出。
图像 1024×1024、视频 512×512/4 秒为低显存探测设置；画质、耗时与显存均未保证。H3 帧网格会令名义 4 秒约为 4.458 秒。

shots.title: 双人菜单确认图
shots.description: 先检查两个人物、颜色和菜单层级。

prompt.visual: One full-frame console-game start-menu concept for "{{game}}" inside a parked camper entertainment screen, not a photograph of a working product. Style: {{style}}. Palette: {{palette}}. Two original adult adventure avatars sit at center: {{player_one}} on the left with crossed ankles and hands behind for support; {{player_two}} on the right with folded legs and hands resting naturally. Use one short player card for each near the upper left, a clear vertical menu on the right and one prominent button reading "CONTINUE". Keep faces unobscured, consistent rounded controls, generous margins, clear warm top light and soft contact shadows. No real-world logo or dense interface walls.
prompt.soundscape: N/A

shots.title: 首帧开场：从待机到就绪
shots.description: 选择已确认菜单图，保留角色身份和左右位置。

prompt.visual: [Shot 1] Begin with the two avatars, framing, typography and colors in <Picture 1>, using {{style}} and {{palette}}. {{player_one}} stays on the left and {{player_two}} on the right. During 0-1s hold the menu. During 1-2.5s the left avatar glances toward the right avatar and gives one small nod; the right avatar smiles back. During 2.5-3.5s the existing CONTINUE button receives one restrained highlight pulse. During 3.5-4s both settle into the same readable pose. Fixed camera, no extra menu labels, no scene transition or warped screen.
prompt.soundscape: One soft selection tick and one low ready chime, with subtle character-clothing movement; no dialogue.
prompt.music: A quiet moderate-tempo pizzicato pattern with a soft two-note woodwind response, no vocals.

shots.title: Ref2VA：双人角色反应镜
shots.description: 用一张已确认双人菜单图锁定角色与视觉语言。

prompt.visual: [Shot 1] In {{style}}, frame the two original players as a medium two-shot in a parked camper game concept. <Subject 1>, {{player_one}}, remains on the left; <Subject 2>, {{player_two}}, remains on the right. Preserve {{palette}} and the established costumes. During 0-1s both look toward a shared off-screen game screen. During 1-3s they raise their nearest hands for one gentle high-five, make contact once, then separate. During 3-4s hold their amused reaction. The camera holds still. No menu text, no extra players, no product branding.
prompt.soundscape: A single soft high-five contact, a short friendly breathy laugh and quiet parked-cabin ambience; no spoken names.
prompt.music: A short light pizzicato phrase, lower than the physical contact sound.

reference.subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the left avatar {{player_one}} in <Picture 1>. <Subject 2> is the right avatar {{player_two}} in <Picture 1>. The picture also supplies the shared {{style}} appearance.
reference.summary: [reference generation] Show the two established avatars completing one friendly high-five while preserving their screen sides and costumes.
reference.retention_analysis: <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> (appear in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - keep identity cues, left/right assignment and costumes. The menu composition of <Picture 1> is not required in this new reaction shot.

templates.name: 3D 动画短片：故事与连续性
templates.summary: 用主动目标、小阻碍和情绪回收组织原创座舱助手故事，先锁角色与无人场景再逐镜生成。

fields.label: 工作标题
fields.default: The Tiny Welcome

fields.label: 主角身份与不可改特征
fields.default: a palm-sized teal service robot with one cream face panel, two round dark eyes and a short orange scarf

fields.label: 同一场景及固定地标
fields.default: a parked family-car cabin; cream rear bench at center, circular roof light above and triangular side window on the right

fields.label: 主角主动目标
fields.default: place a small welcome cushion neatly on the rear bench

fields.label: 小阻碍与预备动作
fields.default: the cushion is slightly too tall for its arms; the robot crouches, braces and tries one careful lift

fields.label: 结尾回收
fields.default: the cushion lands neatly, but the robot's orange scarf is caught beneath it; the robot frees the scarf with a tiny proud bow

stages: 确认一句话目标、障碍和回收
分别锁定角色卡与无人场景卡
检查每秒动作、地标、光位和交接状态
逐镜生成后人工拼接并检查连续性
checklist: 主角是否主动解决小阻碍，结局是否回收前面道具
角色比例、围巾、眼睛和身份轮廓是否跨镜一致
场景描述中的固定地标、道具状态与光位基线是否稳定
动作预备—执行—反应可读，分镜备注或参考卡标签不能进入正片
notes: 模板提供角色卡、场景卡和两段短故事镜头，不是自动完成上游完整长片生产流程。
两段 Ref2VA 默认只引用 <Picture 1> 的主角卡；可手动追加无人场景卡为 Picture 2 并补齐参考说明。卡片上的注释仅供制作，不应进入最终视频。
两段之间的服饰和主要道具状态需人工核对；不能保证自动接续。末帧提取、声音桥接和整片剪辑需外部本地软件。
本模板通过离线表单替换字段，不调用 LLM，不自动核验资料、分析音乐、识别图片或改写用户内容。
逐项选择分镜并手动执行；需要图片输入时，请先保存、检查并自行上传或选择正确参考图，不会自动串联前一步输出。
图像 1024×1024、视频 512×512/4 秒为低显存探测设置；画质、耗时与显存均未保证。H3 帧网格会令名义 4 秒约为 4.458 秒。

shots.title: 原创主角卡
shots.description: 确认主角比例、轮廓、围巾与材质。

prompt.visual: Create a single clean character-design reference for the original short film {{title}}. Character: {{hero}}. Warm stylized 3D animation, rounded geometric masses, soft matte materials, small expressive gestures and a readable silhouette. One large three-quarter full-body view on a neutral cream background, no duplicate characters or multi-panel sheet. Keep the scarf, eye shapes and body proportions clear. No existing franchise character, title text, labels or logos.
prompt.soundscape: N/A

shots.title: 无人场景卡
shots.description: 检查固定地标与光位，不放入人物或机器人。

prompt.visual: One environment-only concept image for {{title}}: {{scene}}. Warm stylized 3D animation with a soft key light from the upper left and a gentle cool fill from the right window. Establish the fixed landmarks and the main prop needed to {{want}}, with unobstructed movement space. No people, robots, hands, faces, silhouettes, labels or storyboard arrows.

From 1-2s reveal exactly one line "{{lyric}}" using this plan: {{type_style}}. From 2-3s the phrase makes one small rhythmic displacement near the window without touching the face. From 3-4s hold the same readable phrase and then stop the motion. Fixed camera, no second lyric, subtitle bar, new person or automatic scene cut.
